title: New supplier onboarding
statement: A new supplier must complete identity, bank-account, sanctions, and conflict-of-interest checks before a purchase order is issued. A supplier handling company or customer data must also complete the security questionnaire and sign the approved data-processing terms. The requester may not approve the supplier's own bank details.

title: Attachment-controlled supplier evidence
statement: For a supplier designated attachment-controlled, a purchase order may be issued only after the security questionnaire is recorded as complete and a PDF copy of the completed questionnaire is attached to the supplier workflow record.

title: Verification-controlled supplier evidence
statement: For a supplier designated verification-controlled, a purchase order may be issued only after the security questionnaire is recorded as complete and independent Compliance verification is recorded. A questionnaire PDF attachment is not required by this rule.
